recommendation: Implement screening and transportation service coordination
implementation_steps: Screen for transportation barriers using validated tools like the AHC 10-item tool
Integrate positive screens into patient care plans with specific transportation solutions
Arrange appropriate transportation services (NEMT, ride-share vouchers, bus passes)
Follow up to confirm service utilization and appointment attendance
Reassess transportation needs at subsequent encounters
evidence_summary: Care coordinator-led screening and transportation service coordination has demonstrated improvements in appointment attendance, medication adherence, and health outcomes for patients with transportation barriers.
